en-US.name: Chief Bot
en-US.summary: Wake your Grok Bot (or any webhook bot) from an Echo. Speaks a short ack; the real work happens async.
en-US.description: Private skill. Say: Alexa, ask chief bot what's on my calendar tomorrow. The skill sends your request to your bot's webhook as read-only and acknowledges immediately. It does not wait for the bot to finish or speak the final answer. Built by Debbie O'Brien.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask chief bot what's on my calendar tomorrow
Alexa, ask chief bot about my meetings this afternoon

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Enable Testing on this skill, link an Echo to the same Amazon developer account, set the HTTPS endpoint to the deployed service. Use mock mode (MOCK_COS=1) first, then set COS_WEBHOOK_URL + COS_WEBHOOK_KEY.
